Bill.BriefDescription: Setting a fee for operation of overweight eductor trucks.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to overweight vehicle permits; amending RCW46.44.0941; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.44.0941 and 1995 c 171 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText:
(1) The following fees, in addition to the regular license andtonnage fees, shall be paid for all movements under special permit madeupon state highways. (3) Subsection (1)(j) of this section applies only to existingvehicles that were in operation before July 1, 2004. After that date,any new vehicle fitting this category that is added to anorganization's existing inventory of such vehicles and causes the totalnumber of vehicles owned by one organization to increase, will not beeligible for the special permit. (4) Organizations operating vehicles of the category provided forin subsection (1)(j) of this section must submit to the department avehicle inventory list indicating how many vehicles they own and thespecifics on each vehicle. This list must be submitted to thedepartment by July 1, 2004. Annually thereafter, each organizationmust submit a new vehicle inventory list specifying if any vehicleshave been replaced or added to its existing inventory.
